No dynamic exact-owner reachability is claimed for DOMAIN_DYNAMIC_AUTHORITY_MISSING or DYNAMIC_NUMERICAL_POLICY_UNACCEPTED under the required ObjectRef declaration surface and closed materialization language; their coverage is static owner-precondition evidence, while required-field omission is I7_RECORD_FORMATION_INVALID.

No settlement allocation is physical measurement or causal contribution, and no settlement operation is authorized.
No Part VII route law exists here; live rerouting must refuse.
No I-8 finalization/recovery/publication/correction or I-9 audit is performed.

scope.domain_boundary: Domain/model/provider declares or measures topology, dependency, route, capacity, policy, delay, numerical policy, and admissibility. EBU represents and validates; it does not discover best topology/route/policy or hidden edges.
excluded: wave, physical phase, superposition, physical interference, or electrical voltage
automatic topology, route, policy, hyperedge, motif, poset, causality, or settlement inference
Part VII route law or successful live rerouting
causal attribution without a frozen protocol
I-8 finalization, provenance, recovery, correction, publication
scientific/model execution, simulation, trajectory, benchmark, result, model state, Gate, book edit, render, commit, push
scope.positive: Exact prospective records and deterministic static mechanics for capacity/topology change, admission, queues/congestion, reservation shortfall, delay, in-transit, rerouting refusal/guard, delayed effects, commitment and policy-memory state interaction under accepted ten-phase ownership.

scope.topology_boundary: Structural, active, and observed topology are distinct roles with status and provenance. Motifs, posets, and hypergraphs are externally declared types/equivalence classes, never inferred laws.
scope.validation_boundary: T0 source/refusal checks plus one-at-a-time T2 exact static fixtures; controlled T3 boundary is fail-closed and cannot issue a permit.

state_and_phase_contract.no_double_application: Every update ref belongs to exactly one component and one physical owner phase; accounting and phase-9 registration only reference the phase-8 effect.

apply declared exogenous topology/failure/repair/capacity changes exactly once
record permitted information; physical update forbidden
form admission partition and queue decision; rejected/pending outside
use accepted I-6 grouping/proposal; no mutation
validate ownership and commit each physical effect exactly once
register transit/effects and update commitment/reservation/status without replaying phase 8
propose declared natural drive for remainder only

rows.math_or_proof: Z_k=(x_k,g_k,q_k,c_k,ell_k); DynamicUpdateRecord requires five disjoint update collections.
rows.meaning: Keep physical x, active topology g, admitted queue/transit q, commitments c, and delayed effects ell distinct.
rows.ordinary_life_example: A delivery van, the road closure, waiting orders, promised deadlines, and a later refund are different facts.
rows.positive_project_value: Prevents silent history loss while giving later models a shared auditable state spine.
rows.why_it_matters: A missing or merged component can make two apparently equal snapshots have different successors.

rows.enables: Time-indexed failures, repairs, isolation, and membership histories without topology discovery.
rows.falsifier_or_refusal: Deleting the required authority ObjectRef fails first as I7_RECORD_FORMATION_INVALID; a well-formed semantic absence has only static owner-precondition coverage, while invalid provenance or layer conflation still fails closed at the exact owner.
rows.math_or_proof: TopologyChangeEvent binds structural_topology_ref plus active before/after refs and a declared/observed provenance arm.
rows.meaning: Structural topology, active topology, and observed topology remain separate typed roles.
rows.ordinary_life_example: A road on a map, a road currently open, and a traffic-camera observation are related but not identical.
rows.positive_project_value: Makes changing connectivity inspectable without pretending EBU inferred hidden edges.
rows.why_it_matters: A declared possible edge is not proof it is active or measured.

rows.enables: Retention of stable identity and commitments while new dispatch is refused.
rows.falsifier_or_refusal: An inferred hidden cut or unsupported transition fails AVAILABILITY_TRANSITION_INVALID.
rows.math_or_proof: AvailabilityStatus accepted prefix plus exact suffix ISOLATED; no other arm changes.
rows.meaning: Append one exact active-status arm for a provider/node/edge that exists structurally but is disconnected for the declared active scope.
rows.ordinary_life_example: A staffed clinic may exist and be functional yet be unreachable after a bridge closure.
rows.positive_project_value: Avoids erasing temporarily disconnected assets from history.
rows.why_it_matters: Failure, repair, degradation, and isolation have different operational consequences.

rows.enables: Exact static capacity screens and explicit shortfalls.
rows.falsifier_or_refusal: Product mismatch or flow above usable capacity fails closed.
rows.math_or_proof: U=alpha times Ubar and 0<=sum f_i<=U, checked exactly in T2 fixtures.
rows.meaning: Installed capacity, availability factor, usable capacity, reserved load, admitted load, and completed flow remain distinct.
rows.ordinary_life_example: A six-seat shuttle with one seat unavailable has five usable seats, not six.
rows.positive_project_value: Gives admission and congestion records a common physical ceiling.
rows.why_it_matters: Counting reservation as flow or ignoring derating can invent service.

rows.enables: Comparable admission histories and later policy audit.
rows.falsifier_or_refusal: Any nonclosing partition or disposition mismatch fails ADMISSION_BALANCE_FAILURE.
rows.meaning: Every presented request is admitted, rejected, or left pending outside the queue exactly once.
rows.ordinary_life_example: At a restaurant, guests may be seated, turned away, or asked to wait before joining the seated queue.
rows.positive_project_value: Separates capacity decisions from subsequent service mechanics.
rows.why_it_matters: Rejected work must not silently inflate or reduce a queue.

assumptions: lossless single-class fixture unless extra typed terms are declared
rows.enables: Exact backlog accounting and testable delay/loss/feasibility effects.
rows.falsifier_or_refusal: Rejected-demand mutation, nonclosing balance, or effect-free congestion fails closed.
rows.math_or_proof: q_{k+1}=q_k+a_k-f_k-z_k, while j_k and d_k remain outside.
rows.meaning: Queue holds admitted but unserved demand; congestion additionally requires a binding rule and an observed/declared effect.
rows.ordinary_life_example: Cars admitted onto a ferry lane wait in that lane; cars diverted before entry do not.
rows.positive_project_value: Lets later work distinguish scarcity, admission, waiting, and actual congestion.
rows.why_it_matters: High utilization alone is not congestion, and rejected requests are not backlog.

rows.enables: Impaired, breached, reroute-proposed, or unresolved commitment histories.
rows.falsifier_or_refusal: Wrong arithmetic or missing commitment link fails closed.
rows.meaning: A later capacity loss does not erase a previously accepted capacity claim or obligation.
rows.ordinary_life_example: Four booked seats remain four promises even when a vehicle failure leaves only three usable seats.
rows.why_it_matters: Priority rules can allocate pain but cannot remove the physical gap.

rows.enables: Deterministic dispatch/arrival timing without fabricated causal shares.
rows.falsifier_or_refusal: Overlap marked additive or total mismatch fails DELAY_DECOMPOSITION_INVALID; deleting required numerical_policy_ref fails earlier as I7_RECORD_FORMATION_INVALID, with DYNAMIC_NUMERICAL_POLICY_UNACCEPTED retained only as a static owner-precondition label under this closed surface.
rows.meaning: Delay is either an exact sum of nonoverlapping declared components or one total with causes kept as annotations.
rows.ordinary_life_example: A train stopped for one ten-minute interval by both a signal and congestion was delayed ten minutes, not twenty.
rows.positive_project_value: Makes timing arithmetic reproducible while keeping causal claims modest.
rows.why_it_matters: Two causes occupying the same elapsed interval cannot both be added.

rows.enables: Auditable handoff and future rerouting once route authority exists.
rows.falsifier_or_refusal: Segment overlap, impossible timing, or inconsistent status fails closed.
rows.math_or_proof: completed segments and unfinished suffix are disjoint; arrival is not before dispatch.
rows.meaning: Dispatched payload remains distinct from arrived, stranded, and lost payload; completed route history is immutable.
rows.ordinary_life_example: A parcel past depot A but blocked before depot B cannot be rerouted as if depot A never handled it.
rows.why_it_matters: A path change cannot rewrite already incurred delay, loss, or resource use.

rows.enables: Honest finite-horizon comparisons and later correction governance.
rows.falsifier_or_refusal: Wrong status/evidence arm or causal claim without protocol fails closed.
rows.math_or_proof: The status arms are mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive for the record.
rows.meaning: Every later effect is matured, pending, cancelled, failed, or unresolved with exact evidence.
rows.ordinary_life_example: A rebate due next month is still pending at this month's close; it has not disappeared.
rows.positive_project_value: Keeps obligations and future physical consequences visible.
rows.why_it_matters: Pending and unknown consequences are not zero.

rows.enables: A stable future integration point without allowing premature route science.
rows.falsifier_or_refusal: Any I-7 live successful RoutePlan return is an authority violation; the exact dynamic refusal witness is direct _DynamicExecutionPermit construction, not a fabricated propose_reroute invocation.
rows.math_or_proof: No valid _DynamicExecutionPermit exists and _validate_route_guard rejects PROVISIONAL_PART_VII; successful return count is zero.
rows.meaning: I-7 names a live proposal interface but supplies no permit and retains PROVISIONAL_PART_VII semantics.
rows.ordinary_life_example: Software can record that a detour is needed without claiming the detour is safe, legal, or passable.
rows.positive_project_value: Makes future routing extensible without weakening current scientific controls.
rows.why_it_matters: A graph path is not yet an authorized physical route law.

rows.enables: Auditable closed-loop reconstruction without calling a policy in static validation.
rows.math_or_proof: All four stateful refs are present together or all are NOT_APPLICABLE.
rows.meaning: Physical state remains separate from policy memory, while stateful replay binds before memory, decision, after memory, and augmented replay state together.
rows.ordinary_life_example: A thermostat's current temperature and its learned schedule are separate, but replay needs both.
rows.positive_project_value: Preserves deterministic replay boundaries for future closed-loop studies.
rows.why_it_matters: Hidden controller history can otherwise make replay nondeterministic.

rows.enables: Traceable within-epoch ordering and phase-level audit.
rows.falsifier_or_refusal: Any ref owned twice fails UPDATE_DOUBLE_APPLICATION_FORBIDDEN.
rows.math_or_proof: DynamicUpdateRecord partitions refs across x,g,q,c,ell and rejects cross-component or phase-8/phase-9 duplicates.
rows.meaning: Each effect is proposed, screened, committed, registered, or naturally driven at its one owning phase.
rows.ordinary_life_example: Charging a card and writing the receipt are two records of one payment, not two payments.
rows.positive_project_value: Reduces silent double-counting across complex dynamic events.
rows.why_it_matters: Accounting must mirror a physical update, not perform it again.

rows.enables: Early deterministic validation of basic identities and refusals.
rows.falsifier_or_refusal: Wrong hash or unallowlisted case/interface fails at the exact _issue_t2_fixture_capability owner; reuse fails at the exact validator, and direct private-permit construction proves T3 refusal.
rows.feature: T2 static fixtures and T3 control
rows.math_or_proof: The allowlist has exactly six I-7 rows and one interface; each capability is consumed once.
rows.meaning: Six hand-derived cases run one at a time under exact one-use capabilities; live science remains T3 and unavailable.
rows.ordinary_life_example: Checking six calculator examples is not operating the transport network.
rows.positive_project_value: Builds confidence in mechanics without spending scientific authority.
rows.why_it_matters: Arithmetic checks should not become a disguised trajectory or policy experiment.

rows.enables: Reusable typed records across domains without a universal optimizer.
rows.falsifier_or_refusal: Deleting a required authority field fails I7_RECORD_FORMATION_INVALID before semantics. DOMAIN_DYNAMIC_AUTHORITY_MISSING is retained honestly as a static owner-precondition label because the closed surface has no typed missing-authority value or runtime resolver; inferred hidden relations remain forbidden.
rows.math_or_proof: Every relevant record carries domain_authority_ref or declaring_authority_ref; no discover/best/infer callable exists.
rows.meaning: Domains/providers declare or measure topology, dependency, route, capacity, delay, policy, and admissibility; EBU represents and validates.
rows.ordinary_life_example: A hospital declares which ambulance routes and capacities are valid; the ledger checks the declaration instead of inventing roads.
rows.positive_project_value: Keeps the framework broadly useful without overclaiming scientific expertise.
rows.why_it_matters: Generic data cannot establish hidden edges, best policy, causality, or entitlement.

projection.encoding: canonical JSON with Unicode code-point key order, no insignificant whitespace, and one final LF
projection.missing_field_rule: omit fields absent from the stored vector row
